_purpose: Reels that must not go into the repost queue. The scorer hard-excludes every entry in `excluded`.
_why_this_lives_in_git: posts.db is gitignored and gets rebuilt by backfill.py. This is irreplaceable human judgment, so it is versioned, travels with the repo, and survives any database rebuild.

_reasons.event_promo: Tied to a dated event. Reposting tells people a gig is happening that already happened - someone could turn up at a venue on the wrong night. Never repost while this entry stands.
_reasons.dated_claim: Makes a time-bound claim that would be false today (a release, an announcement, a milestone).
_reasons.rights: Music, footage or a collaborator's likeness that cannot be re-published.
_reasons.retired: Superseded, or no longer represents the player.

_verdicts.video_is_promotional: The footage itself is the advert - a poster, a flyer, an animated announcement. Nothing to salvage; keep excluded permanently.
_verdicts.caption_only_dated: The footage is an ordinary performance or practice clip; only the caption announced a date. Since a repost gets a new caption anyway (phase-1-repost-engine.md section 4), these are probably repostable. Held out until someone watches the video and confirms there is no on-screen date, venue name or poster frame.

_provenance: added_by `human` was judged by watching the video. added_by `claude-proposed` was inferred from the caption text alone by the flag sweep on 2026-08-18 - accurate about the caption, guessing about the footage. Confirm, then either flip to `human` or delete the entry.

excluded.note: "Latin Jazz Night 22.8 Sat 21:30 at Frau Mayer Rudolfsplatz 12, 1010 Wien". Full street address and a 14-second runtime - this is a flyer, not a performance.

"Next week in @fraumayerwien ... Poster by @jwsst__" - the caption credits a poster designer, so the footage is the poster. Also the one reel durations.py could not read, so it was already outside the cohort.
Frau Mayer Latin Dance Party, 23 May 20:15. Date and venue are the content.
"Playing tomorrow at @miles.smiles.vienna, see you there". Made to fill a room on a specific night.

Concert invitation for Porgy & Bess on 26 January - but the caption itself says "You are listening in the video to one of my latest composition: Island Songs", with the full 15-musician ensemble credited. The footage is the composition, not the advert. This one reached rank 13 of the queue.
excluded.action_needed: Strongest reuse candidate of the four. Island Songs is evergreen material; only the concert pitch was dated.

reviewed_not_excluded.note: "Practicing for the upcoming gigs!" names no date, no venue, no specific event. Reposting it cannot mislead anyone about a live show. This is the detector's one false positive across 141 reels.
